newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold mixed in mild trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold mixed in mild trade.

text.p: Gold prices ended mixed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Friday amid narrow demand from the free market, dealers said.
Gold closed at $383.10 an ounce, down $0.60 from Thursday in line with European trends. In lira terms, the close was 1,117,700 lira per gram, up 3,200 from yesterday due to a weak lira.
The Turkish lira weakened to 90,420 to the dollar on the interbank from Thursday's 90,170 close.

Dealers said demand faded in the last two days after vigorous trade earlier in the week. Traded volume was 595 kilos, up from Thursday's 235 and compared to a daily volume of between 935 and 1,335 kilos earlier.
Volume rose to 385 kilos in the second session from 210 in the morning. 79 percent of the total trade was made in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
